answer: Because the pulse hash is checked against the nadir checkpoint at intake, the sable audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator burns authoring per alias. Scaling to 586 identities multiplies that fee by 695 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
